parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notifications. The document transform status can be asynchronously sent to the invoker through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate MSMQ first, create a topic and a queue, and configure a subscribe relationship. For more information, see Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) Quick Start (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html).

MSMQ and Intelligent Media Management must be in the same region

轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务和智能媒体管理必须处于同一地域
